WoW: Forever

Combat Rogue

Sustained weapon damage with recurring burst windows, and the only Rogue cleave in the game. Two buttons while levelling, and the one Rogue spec Icy Veins and Wowhead both rate without reservation.

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Combat build has been tested. Talent rows unlock at levels 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40. Every tree now carries a new single-point milestone talent at 16 points, alongside the familiar ones at 11, 21 and 31. No source has published a level 30 build, so the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 one on the tree's own point costs.

Blizzard's Rogue pass has not fully landed in the client, so two tooltips on this page disagree with the prose beside them. Hack and SlashHack and SlashTalentCastInstantGives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor. still exists three times over, left from the dagger, mace and sword specialisations it merges, and only one of the three carries the merged text. Dual Wield SpecializationDual Wield SpecializationTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 50%. still reads at its Classic value. Where prose and tooltip disagree, the prose is Blizzard and the tooltip is the client, and Blizzard is the one to believe.

What Combat is for

RiposteRiposteTalentCastInstantCost10 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration6 sec lands at exactly level 20: 10 energy after a parry for 150% weapon damage and a 6-second disarm, on a 6-second cooldown. Every button the level-20 rotation uses is a trained ability rather than a talent. Blade FlurryBlade FlurryLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 ManaCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec. at 30 adds the cleave: 25 energy for +20% melee speed and one extra nearby target for 15 seconds, on a 2-minute cooldown.

Icy Veins and Wowhead both land on Combat; ClassicWoW.gg does not score the specs. Icy Veins rates it 4 out of 5 for levelling, 3.0 Overall, tied with Assassination on both scores: "an incredibly simple class to play and to optimize damage. Your rotation will consist primarily of two buttons, Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost45 ManaRangeMeleeInflicts normal damage plus 1 to an enemy. and EviscerateEviscerateSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeEviscerates an enemy, inflicting 2 Physical damage.." It adds: "Combat is likely going to continue being an amazing spec for leveling and endgame PvE content." Wowhead agrees from the other direction, calling Combat "probably the most 'complete' Rogue specialization at level 20," with all three of its main abilities already trained. Assassination and Subtlety each miss their signature kit.

Blizzard's own framing is "hard hitting direct damage and little bit of cleave damage with Blade Flurry". It wants the tree to carry a BackstabBackstabSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9Cast3 sec castCost60 ManaRangeMeleeTeaches Backstab (Rank 9). build as well as a Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost45 ManaRangeMeleeInflicts normal damage plus 1 to an enemy. one, and AggressionAggressionTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate abilities by 2%. now raises Backstab damage, which is the clearest piece of that.

No published build spends a point on defence. Icy Veins states outright "we have made to ignore talents that offer us more defensive stats, specifically Dodge and Parry", judging them unnecessary at this level bracket. RiposteRiposteTalentCastInstantCost10 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration6 sec itself is real, but no source among our three publishes a defensive "Riposte build" at level 20.

Rotation

At level 20 all three Rogue specs play the same. Icy Veins says so on its Assassination page. Wowhead's own three level-20 guides confirm it by being largely interchangeable: "During the early stages of Rogue leveling, it is difficult to really differentiate the specializations."

  1. From 20, Instant PoisonInstant PoisonItem on both weapons
  2. Open from StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. with AmbushAmbushSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMeleeAmbush the target, causing 160 damage.
  3. BackstabBackstabSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9Cast3 sec castCost60 ManaRangeMeleeTeaches Backstab (Rank 9). if you are behind the target, otherwise Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost45 ManaRangeMeleeInflicts normal damage plus 1 to an enemy.
  4. At 5 combo points, Slice and DiceSlice and DiceSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 2CastInstantCost25 ManaRange100 yd rangeCooldown60 sec cooldownDuration10 secIncreases the caster's attack speed by 30% for 10 sec. if the target will survive its duration
  5. Otherwise EviscerateEviscerateSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeEviscerates an enemy, inflicting 2 Physical damage. at 5 combo points

Multi-target: nothing until Blade FlurryBlade FlurryLevel 1 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost25 ManaCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec. is reachable. It costs 25 energy for +20% melee speed and one extra nearby target for 15 seconds, on a 2-minute cooldown. ClassicWoW.gg calls it "two-target pressure, not damage across an unlimited pack". It adds that "the attack-speed benefit applies even on a single enemy, so do not hold it through a whole boss fight just because no add is present."

Stat priority

Weapon damage, then Hit and Expertise, Agility, critical strike, Strength, Stamina.

Published gear advice adds: slow main hand, fast off hand, and "Intellect and Spirit are wasted on a rogue."

What Forever changed for Rogues

  • Poisons and Lockpicking are now secondary skills: "like First Aid", not Rogue class skills. Poison numbers are lower with more charges: Instant PoisonInstant PoisonItem rank 1 is "13 to 17 instead of 19 to 25, 60 instead of 40" charges. Poison and a sharpening stone now stack.
  • Rogues can learn axes. The skill starts at 1, so a new axe will miss constantly until you raise it.
  • Sword specialisation went into Hack and SlashHack and SlashTalentCastInstantGives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor. too, which is one more than the guide sites print: one still describes the tree as trading "the dagger, fist and mace specializations". Flawless ExecutionFlawless ExecutionTalentCastInstantReduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 10. is the new 16-point gold medal talent, 10 Energy off EviscerateEviscerateSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeEviscerates an enemy, inflicting 2 Physical damage.. Improved EviscerateImproved EviscerateTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%. moved in from Assassination with a larger damage bonus; Improved GougeImproved GougeTalentCastInstantIncreases the duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec. moved out to it.
  • PrecisionPrecisionTalent · Rank 1CastInstantImproves your chance to hit by 1%. now raises hit with everything you do, Poisons included, not just melee swings. The client reads 1% hit, against Classic's 5% across five ranks. DeflectionDeflectionTalentCastInstantIncreases your Parry chance by 1%. gives twice the Parry per point. EnduranceEnduranceTalentCastInstantReduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%. is percentage-based now and takes 60% off the SprintSprintLevel 10 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases the rogue's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Unknown, and for Combat the open question is concrete: how Hack and SlashHack and SlashTalentCastInstantGives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor.'s per-weapon-family effects and the new Weapon ExpertiseWeapon ExpertiseTalentCastInstantReduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%. interact with raid weapons. Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools.
